d: BP Mandal was the sixth Chief Minister of Bihar. BP Mandal had been appointed as the chairman of second backward class commission known as Mandal Commission in 1978 of which recommendations were accepted by the central government in August 1990. It later led to a nationwide student protest and a series of self-immolation. First self-immolation attempt was made by a Delhi university student named Rajiv Goswami then the chaos spread in the entire nation. Watch this latest episode of The Lallantop's special political series named Mukhyamantri by Editor Saurabh Dwivedi for more details.
